name: Angel Dust
source: Hell’s most famous and desired porn star, prostitute, and stripper. Despite being gay, he will service both male and female customers, for the right price. His seductive, glamorous demeanor belies hidden vulnerabilities. He considers Kumakko to be an annoyance.
